scope: higher coefficient pooling with row tags and exponent markings
limitations: Source rows and coefficient arithmetic are charged. The source still has B^(3/2) inputs. The dense bivariate recurrence may store quadratic prefixes even though its final two heads have O(B) coefficients. Equal label sums alone lose the factor-bearing index orientation. Fixed-base kernels remain exposed. No every-run bit-cost theorem is certified.

lean_validation.scope: Focused module build, ordinary root import, all namespace declarations/helpers, source scan and exact diagnostic replay. No publication or wider gates.
lean_validation.unverified_implementation: GMP polynomial/remainder evaluation, dense coefficient recurrence, public coefficient-order scan and total bit-operation cost. The Lean identities certify the meaning of original-source heads and the checked-unit decoder; no every-run cost theorem is certified.
lean_validation.formal_control_scope: Two generic original interval rows over ZMod 35. This is a decoder control, not the universal centre-free cover.
lean_validation.prototype_operation_counter_scope: coefficient_updates counts scaling, tag multiplication and polynomial addition slots inside tagged_heads. All setup and normalization are included in timings, but this counter is not a full program bit-cost certificate.
